title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
innovation_summary: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages: We present IndicTalk, one of the largest multilingual Indic code-mixed conversational corpora, comprising over 13,28,604 event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties covering 9 Indic languages.
